title: orders-api 5xx while inventory-service responses stalled
symptoms: elevated 5xx rate on the alerting service
elevated p95 latency on the alerting service
circuit breaker or retry storms toward one dependency
brief increase in held database connections while waiting on I/O
read/connect timeouts naming a downstream host
observed_signals: db utilization rose only where the caller held connections during the wait
retries increased request rate slightly without a user-traffic surge
error rate rose after outbound calls started timing out
timeout logs named a specific dependency, not the local database

timeline.event: orders-api began retrying calls to inventory-service
circuit breaker or retry logs referenced inventory-service
inventory-service recovered or was isolated; caller errors receded

contributing_factors: the caller had no fallback for that route
resolution: capped retries to stop amplifying load on inventory-service
worked with the dependency owners on saturation of their pool
added synthetic checks against inventory-service from the same region
lessons_learned: fallback and circuit breaking should be tested, not only documented
held DB connections during a slow downstream call are a side effect of waiting, not a saturated local pool
